text: 金十数据10月13日讯，据法新社报道，也门胡塞武装政治局成员布海提12日表示，如果美国参与针对也门的侵略，胡塞武装将会作出迅速且令人痛苦的回应，胡塞武装将打击美国及其在该地区的所有利益目标。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 13: According to AFP, Buhaite, a member of the political bureau of Yemen's Houthi armed group, said on the 12th that if the United States participates in aggression against Yemen, the Houthis will make a rapid and painful response, and the Houthis will strike the United States and all its targets of interest in the region.
